assignments.name: title
assignments.value: Adaptive XR Wayfinding for Dense Museum Exhibitions

assignments.name: abstract
assignments.value: This paper studies adaptive extended reality cues for helping visitors navigate dense museum exhibitions.

assignments.name: content
assignments.value: The study deploys a smartphone-based augmented reality museum guide in three gallery layouts. Visitors follow navigation cues while viewing physical artifacts. The evaluation compares route clarity, artifact recall, attention, and perceived curatorial coherence. Results indicate that subtle spatial cues improve navigation without pulling attention away from exhibits.

parameters.jsCode:
const body = $json.body || $json;
const title = String(body.title || '').trim();
const abstract = String(body.abstract || '').trim();
const content = String(body.content || abstract).trim().slice(0, 80000);
if (!title) throw new Error('Request must include title');
if (!content) throw new Error('Request must include a PDF, content, or abstract');
const inferredFullText = Boolean(body.content && String(body.content).trim() !== abstract);
const allowedQuality = ['warn', 'strict', 'off'];
return [{
  json: {
    inputSource: String(body.inputSource || 'api').trim(),
    briefOnly: body.briefOnly === true || String(body.inputSource || '').trim() === 'website-brief',
    userTaskToken: String(body.userTaskToken || '').trim(),
    id: String(body.id || title).trim(),
    title,
    venue: String(body.venue || 'Publication').trim(),
    abstract,
    content,
    contentSource: String(body.contentSource || (inferredFullText ? 'inline-content' : 'abstract')).trim(),
    contentMode: String(body.contentMode || (inferredFullText ? 'fulltext' : 'abstract')).trim(),
    visualStrategy: String(body.visualStrategy || '').trim(),
    strategyLabel: String(body.strategyLabel || '').trim(),
    strategyPrompt: String(body.strategyPrompt || '').trim(),
    strategyNegativePrompt: String(body.strategyNegativePrompt || '').trim(),
    strategyVisualRoles: Array.isArray(body.strategyVisualRoles) ? body.strategyVisualRoles : [],
    strategyCompositions: Array.isArray(body.strategyCompositions) ? body.strategyCompositions : [],
    visualFingerprint: body.visualFingerprint && typeof body.visualFingerprint === 'object' ? body.visualFingerprint : {},
    visualAnchors: Array.isArray(body.visualAnchors) ? body.visualAnchors : [],
    imageSafetyPolicy: Array.isArray(body.imageSafetyPolicy) ? body.imageSafetyPolicy : [],
    evidenceSnippets: Array.isArray(body.evidenceSnippets) ? body.evidenceSnippets : [],
    sourceFigures: Array.isArray(body.sourceFigures) ? body.sourceFigures.slice(0, 5) : (Array.isArray(body.figures) ? body.figures.slice(0, 5) : []),
    referenceImages: Array.isArray(body.referenceImages) ? body.referenceImages.slice(0, 5) : [],
    referenceMode: ['auto','off','required'].includes(String(body.referenceMode || '').toLowerCase()) ? String(body.referenceMode).toLowerCase() : 'auto',
    referenceStrength: Math.max(0.35, Math.min(Number(body.referenceStrength || 0.6), 0.8)),
    audience: String(body.audience || 'general-public').trim(),
    communicationGoal: String(body.communicationGoal || 'show-application').trim(),
    visualStyle: String(body.visualStyle || body.imageStyle || 'auto').trim(),
    outputProfile: ['website-header','xiaohongshu-cover'].includes(String(body.outputProfile || '').toLowerCase()) ? String(body.outputProfile).toLowerCase() : 'website-header',
    aestheticProfile: String(body.aestheticProfile || 'auto').trim().toLowerCase(),
    styleRecipe: body.styleRecipe && typeof body.styleRecipe === 'object' ? body.styleRecipe : {},
    aestheticRecipe: body.aestheticRecipe && typeof body.aestheticRecipe === 'object' ? body.aestheticRecipe : {},
    outputRecipe: body.outputRecipe && typeof body.outputRecipe === 'object' ? body.outputRecipe : {},
    communicationBrief: body.communicationBrief && typeof body.communicationBrief === 'object' ? body.communicationBrief : {},
    imageProviderMode: ['automatic', 'qwen', 'comfyui', 'dual'].includes(String(body.imageProviderMode || '').toLowerCase()) ? String(body.imageProviderMode).toLowerCase() : 'automatic',
    sourcePolicy: String(body.sourcePolicy || 'balanced').trim(),
    peoplePolicy: String(body.peoplePolicy || body.visualFingerprint?.peoplePolicy || 'optional').trim(),
    qualityMode: allowedQuality.includes(String(body.qualityMode || '').toLowerCase()) ? String(body.qualityMode).toLowerCase() : 'warn',
    sourceImage: String(body.sourceImage || '').trim(),
    sourceImageAlt: String(body.sourceImageAlt || '').trim(),
    showTitle: body.showTitle !== false,
  },
}];

={{JSON.stringify({
  articleSlug: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.articleSlug,

  coverHeadline: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.coverHeadline,
  showTitle: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.showTitle,

  contentSource: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.contentSource,
  contentMode: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.contentMode,
  visualBrief: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.visualBrief,
  visualMode: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.visualMode,
  visualStrategy: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.visualMode,
  strategyLabel: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.paperType,
  methodSummary: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.methodSummary,
  visualFingerprint: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.visualFingerprint,
  visualAnchors: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.uniqueAnchors,
  evidence: $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.evidence,
  alt: 'Deterministic academic thumbnail for ' + $('Parse Visual Brief JSON').first().json.title
})}}

={{JSON.stringify({
  model: $env.DEEPSEEK_MODEL || 'deepseek-chat',
  temperature: 0.2,
  max_tokens: 2800,
  thinking: { type: 'disabled' },
  stream: false,
  response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
  messages: [
    {
      role: 'system',
      content: `You are an evidence-focused academic visual editor. Return strict JSON only. Required keys: paperType, visualRole, coreMessage, coverHeadline, evidence, limitations, mustAvoidClaims, mainSubject, environment, action, technology, supportingObjects, forbiddenObjects, uniqueAnchors, peoplePolicy, handsRequired, methodSummary, prompt, alternativePrompt, negativePrompt, alt, sourceFigureRanking. paperType must be one of algorithm-computational, system-interface, hci-xr, lab-experiment, field-study, design-cocreation, digital-heritage, audio-soundscape, hardware-wearable, review-survey. visualRole must be one of source-evidence, artifact-closeup, study-context, interaction-scene, method-summary, editorial-concept. evidence is an array of up to five objects with claim, sourceSection, and sourceText. sourceText must be a short verbatim excerpt from the supplied title, abstract, article text, or figure caption. Every object, device, person, place, material, and activity in mustShow and the prompts must be supported by evidence. Never invent a brand, author appearance, location, device, participant, experiment, or result. mainSubject, environment, action, technology, supportingObjects, and forbiddenObjects form a single concrete scene specification. Use one main subject, one environment, one action, one technology, and at most two supporting objects. uniqueAnchors must contain three to eight concrete paper-specific nouns or short noun phrases. Avoid generic anchors such as researcher, technology, laboratory, computer, data, or AI. For computational or review papers, prefer method-summary or a restrained concrete application-domain still life and do not invent an experiment. For empirical papers, choose an artifact, study context, or interaction supported by the paper. prompt and alternativePrompt must use clearly different composition roles. Resolve conflicts explicitly: handsRequired may be true only when the evidenced action cannot be shown without a hand; otherwise avoid visible hands. Respect the requested output profile, visual style recipe, and aesthetic recipe. Compose for the requested output profile: use 3:2 for website-header and 3:4 for xiaohongshu-cover, with one focal subject, few elements, and quiet space for optional programmatic title layout. Never request readable text, labels, logos, equations, charts with labels, or a poster. The image model creates a text-free background only. coverHeadline must be concise Chinese, understandable to the selected audience, supported by the paper, and must not use hype such as first-ever, completely solves, perfectly accurate, revolutionary, or guaranteed. peoplePolicy is none, optional, or required. methodSummary is null unless a deterministic method visual is suitable; when used, include domainLabel, inputs (maximum three), fusionLabel, outcomeLabel, and benefitLabel using short terms found in the paper. sourceFigureRanking ranks supplied figure ids by relevance and explains each choice. Write concise English values.`
    },
    {
      role: 'user',
      content: 'Title: ' + $json.title
        + '\nVenue: ' + $json.venue
        + '\nAbstract: ' + $json.abstract
        + '\nContent source: ' + $json.contentSource
        + '\nContent mode: ' + $json.contentMode
        + '\nTarget audience: ' + $json.audience
        + '\nCommunication goal: ' + $json.communicationGoal
        + '\nOutput profile: ' + $json.outputProfile
        + '\nVisual style: ' + $json.visualStyle
        + '\nAesthetic profile: ' + $json.aestheticProfile
        + '\nStyle recipe: ' + JSON.stringify($json.styleRecipe || {})
        + '\nAesthetic recipe: ' + JSON.stringify($json.aestheticRecipe || {})
        + '\nExisting shared communication brief: ' + JSON.stringify($json.communicationBrief || {})
        + '\nSource policy: ' + $json.sourcePolicy
        + '\nConfigured paper type: ' + ($json.visualStrategy || '')
        + '\nConfigured label: ' + ($json.strategyLabel || '')
        + '\nAllowed visual roles: ' + ($json.strategyVisualRoles || []).join(', ')
        + '\nComposition roles: ' + ($json.strategyCompositions || []).join(', ')
        + '\nConfigured direction: ' + ($json.strategyPrompt || '')
        + '\nExisting evidence snippets: ' + ($json.evidenceSnippets || []).join(' | ')
        + '\nPDF figure candidates: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.sourceFigures || []).map((figure) => ({ id: figure.id, pageNumber: figure.pageNumber, caption: figure.caption, sourceScore: figure.sourceScore })))
        + '\n\nCleaned article text:\n' + $json.content
    }
  ]
})}}
